consequence.statement: Unless Flux Operator is used to deploy the Flux controllers, `flux migrate` must be run on the cluster before upgrading to Flux 2.7.0; if the operator does nothing, the migration off the removed v1beta1/v2beta1 APIs is not performed.
consequence.remediation: Run `flux migrate` on clusters before upgrading to Flux 2.7.0 (not required when Flux Operator is used to deploy the Flux controllers); see the Flux v2.7 upgrade guide linked in the release notes.

assertion.statement: The Flux APIs v1beta1 and v2beta1 (deprecated in 2023) have reached end-of-life and have been removed from the CRDs in Flux 2.7.0, and clusters not using Flux Operator to deploy the Flux controllers must run `flux migrate` before upgrading.
